input: Steps to build a pivot table from data in Excel
expected: Open the workbook and click any cell in your source range. Go to Insert > PivotTable. In the dialog, confirm the table/range and choose New Worksheet. In the PivotTable Fields pane, drag a categorical field to Rows, a metric to Values, optionally another dimension to Columns. Use Value Field Settings to change aggregation (Sum/Count/Avg). Apply number formatting, add slicers, and refresh as needed with Data > Refresh. Keep the source as a proper Excel Table for stability.
accepted: Select your data, choose Insert > PivotTable, pick the range, and place the PivotTable on a new worksheet. Drag fields to Rows, Columns, and Values.
Insert > PivotTable, select the table/range, choose New Worksheet, then arrange fields in the field list.

input: Freeze header row in Excel
expected: Use View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row.
accepted: View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row.

input: How do I add page numbers in Word?
expected: Insert > Page Number > choose a position and style.

input: Where do I find page numbering in Word?
expected: Go to Insert, select Page Number, then choose Top or Bottom of Page.

input: How do I track changes in Word?
expected: Review > Track Changes to toggle it on. Use Simple Markup to view edits.

input: Turn on Track Changes in Word
expected: Open the Review tab and select Track Changes.

input: Start the PowerPoint presentation from the beginning
expected: Press F5 or choose Slide Show > From Beginning.

input: How do I present from the first slide in PowerPoint?
expected: Use Slide Show > From Beginning or press F5.

input: Create a rule to move emails in Outlook
expected: Home > Rules > Create Rule, set the condition and choose the destination folder.

input: How to automatically move messages to a folder in Outlook?
expected: Open Home > Rules > Create Rule and pick the criteria and folder.

input: Schedule an email to send later in Outlook
expected: Compose the email, go to Options > Delay Delivery, tick Do not deliver before, then pick date/time.

input: How long are deleted files kept in OneDrive?
expected: OneDrive keeps items in the recycle bin for about 30 days by default.

input: Blur my background in Microsoft Teams
expected: Before joining, toggle Effects and avatars > Blur. In-meeting: More > Effects and avatars > Blur.

input: Create a private channel in Teams
expected: Go to a team, choose More options > Add channel, set Privacy to Private and add members.

input: How do I make a private channel in Microsoft Teams?
expected: Open the team, select Add channel, set Privacy to Private, then add people.

input: Create a new list in SharePoint
expected: From your site, select New > List, choose Blank list or from a template, then name and create it.

input: How do I use VLOOKUP in Excel?
expected: =VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, FALSE) for exact match.

input: VLOOKUP across sheets in Excel
expected: Use =VLOOKUP(A2, 'Sheet2'!A:B, 2, FALSE) to pull a value from another sheet.

input: How do I change the theme?
expected: Ambiguous: specify the app (Word/PowerPoint/Windows) and scope (document, slide master, OS).

input: Export to PDF
Turn on dark mode in Office
expected: Yes.

input: How to paste in Excel?
expected: Press Ctrl+V to paste.

input: Create a pivot and format the range as a table
expected: First format as a table via Home > Format as Table; then Insert > PivotTable.

input: Share a OneDrive file externally
expected: Select the file, Share > Anyone with the link, set permissions, and send the link.

input: Embed a video in a PowerPoint slide
expected: Insert > Video > This Device (or Online Video), choose the file, then resize on the slide.

input: Count duplicates in an Excel column
expected: Use COUNTIF: =COUNTIF(A:A, A2) then filter values >1.

input: How do I find repeated values in a column in Excel?
expected: Apply Conditional Formatting > Highlight Cells Rules > Duplicate Values, or use COUNTIF to count repeats.

input: Insert a table of contents in Word
expected: Apply heading styles, then References > Table of Contents > choose an automatic style.

input: Schedule a meeting in Teams
expected: Calendar > New meeting, add title, attendees, time, then Send.

input: Add a signature in Outlook
expected: File > Options > Mail > Signatures, create a new signature and set it as default.
